# HTTP Status Code Reference

Quick reference for HTTP status codes.

## 2xx Success
- 200 OK
- 201 Created
- 204 No Content

## 3xx Redirection
- 301 Moved Permanently
- 304 Not Modified

## 4xx Client Error
- 400 Bad Request
- 401 Unauthorized
- 403 Forbidden
- 404 Not Found
- 429 Too Many Requests

## 5xx Server Error
- 500 Internal Server Error
- 502 Bad Gateway
- 503 Service Unavailable
